option_relations.rationale: Option A describes a specific type of orbital metastasis (perineural spread of metastatic melanoma to the orbit), making it a subtype of the broader 'Orbital Metastasis' leaf.
Option B describes a specific type of orbital metastasis (malignant melanoma with perineural and orbital metastasis), making it a subtype of the broader 'Orbital Metastasis' leaf.
Option C describes a specific type of orbital metastasis (neurotropic melanoma with orbital spread), making it a subtype of the broader 'Orbital Metastasis' leaf.
Option D, 'Metastatic melanoma to the orbit', is directly equivalent to the leaf 'Orbital Metastasis' in the context of the vignette where melanoma is the primary cancer.
